meta_description:
1,859 likes, 51 comments - financebyanmoll on September 13, 2026: "In this post, I’ve compared both exchanges across valuations, revenue growth, profit growth and market share.

In recent years, BSE has clearly grown faster across multiple metrics, which means NSE will need to step up to maintain its dominance.

But NSE still has a major advantage in terms of scale, trading volumes and a more diversified revenue mix.

So while BSE has been gaining ground, NSE still has the strength to make a strong comeback.

And ultimately, both can continue to grow and coexist in India’s stock exchange duopoly.

#nseipo".
